description: Golden set for chatbot help retrieval (FAQs + knowledge base). 'tuning' items were used to choose the threshold and FAQ representation; 'heldout' items were written afterwards and never used for tuning. 'expected' lists title substrings, any of which counts as correct. 'off_topic' questions share no subject with the help content and must retrieve nothing. 'hard_negative' questions mention PredictiX subjects (places, features) that the help content does not answer: retrieval may return related items, so the answer step must reply that the question is not covered (checked by the live-LLM evaluation).
